label: prf:categorical-action-unique
title: Proof of uniqueness of the categorical action
html: The rigid structure (\mathrm{ev}_A, \mathrm{coev}_A) is part of the QOU datum and is unique up to canonical isomorphism. Given fixed \Phi, the composite \mathrm{ev}_A \circ (\mathrm{id}_{A^\vee} \otimes \Phi) \circ \mathrm{coev}_A is therefore uniquely determined as a morphism \mathbf{1} \to \mathbf{1}. This composite is, by definition, the categorical trace \mathrm{tr}(\Phi); hence \mathfrak{S}_\Phi = \mathrm{tr}(\Phi) is unique.
heading: Proof
